title: Concepts
subtitle: data → draft → validate → save → resetDraft
content: Form never fetches. It manages source data, local draft overrides, validation, optional persist, and save via a mutator you provide.

sections.title: Pipeline
sections.content:
1. **data** — authoritative source (from props, query, store, etc.)
2. **draft** — `data` plus path overrides from `set` / arrays
3. **validate?** — field validators and/or `zodResolver`
4. **persist?** — optional draft/cache hydration via localStorage or custom storage
5. **save(mutator)** — validate → `mutator(draft, meta)` → **resetDraft** on success
6. Fresh **data** comes from refetch / `setData` — **not** from applying the save result

sections.title: Source updates
sections.content:
`setData` / config `data` changes apply `sourceUpdate`:

- `keepDirty` (default) — keep overrides that still differ from the new source
- `resetDraft` / `replaceAll` — clear overrides and field meta

sections.title: What form does not do
sections.content:
• No built-in fetch or query cache
• No Collection / list-of-forms API (parked)
• Mutator success does not write `data` — you compose with query invalidate or `setData`
